candidate.answerReason: The last four groups include every score of at least 60 exactly once; their frequencies sum to 38.

methods.label: Add the included groups
methods.explanation: Scores of 60 points or above include the last four groups: \(6+14+12+6=38\) students.
methods.levelReason: This requires interpreting the stated group boundaries and adding frequencies, both within Grade 7.

methods.label: Subtract the excluded group
methods.explanation: Only the group \([50,60)\) is below 60, and it contains 2 students. Every other student scored at least 60, since 60 belongs to \([60,70)\). Subtracting the excluded group from the class total gives \(40-2=38\) students.
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary whole-minus-part reasoning and the given interval boundaries.

review.levelCheck: Both methods use accessible Grade 7 interval interpretation and elementary arithmetic.
